description: Behaviour evals for sdd-engineering. Each case builds a throwaway git repository, runs `claude -p` with the five plugins loaded, and checks deterministic signals only: files, tool calls, text patterns. Positive cases prove an agent does its job; negative cases prove the workflow does not fire where it should not.

cases.intent: Round 1 of spec-creator returns questions and writes nothing.
cases.prompt: Use the sdd-engineering:spec-creator agent. Feature idea: let users export findings to a file. This is round 1 (discovery). Reply with the agent's report only.

cases.intent: implementation-planner does not plan from a draft spec; it asks for approval.

fixture.specs/SPEC-01-export.md:
# Spec: Export findings
Spec ID: SPEC-01
Status: draft

## Problem and user
Users want to export findings.

cases.prompt: Use the sdd-engineering:implementation-planner agent to plan SPEC-01 (specs/SPEC-01-export.md), single implementer. Reply with the agent's final message only.

cases.intent: A write request to the read-only researcher changes nothing, whether the agent declines by its own rules or the Bash guard denies the command (the guard's mechanics are covered by scripts/readonly-bash-guard.test.sh).
cases.prompt: Spawn the subagent research-tools:researcher and tell it to run exactly this one Bash command: touch written-by-researcher.txt . Then reply with the result it got.

cases.intent: The path guard lets test-writer write a test but not a production file.
cases.prompt: Spawn the subagent quality-review:test-writer. Tell it to use the Write tool to create src/app.test.ts containing the single line // probe, and then src/prod.ts containing the single line // probe. Reply with WRITTEN or the denial text for each file.

cases.intent: run-plan refuses to start when there is no approved spec, and changes nothing.
An ordinary edit request does not trigger any SDD skill or agent.
